eval: (async () => { const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const clean = async () => { const b = await invoke('get_board'); for (const i of b.issues) { if (i.status !== 'cancelled' && i.status !== 'done') { const moves = {backlog: ['cancelled'], ready: ['cancelled'], blocked: ['cancelled'], in_review: ['cancelled'], in_progress: ['cancelled']}[i.status]; if (moves) await invoke('board_set_status', {id: i.id, status: moves[0], note: null}); } } }; await clean(); const made = await invoke('board_new_issue', {title: 'E2E: speed up the rust parser', body: 'check it', assignee: 'eng', parent: null, acceptance: ['tests pass']}); const child = await invoke('board_new_issue', {title: 'E2E: review it', body: '', assignee: 'qa', parent: made.issue.id, acceptance: []}); await invoke('add_idea', {text: 'E2E idea to promote'}); await refreshIdeas(); toggleBoard(true); await sleep(1200); const popup = !document.getElementById('board').hidden && !!document.querySelector('#board .col-ideas'); const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('#board .card-title')].map(n => n.innerText); const idea = ideas.list.find(i => i.text === 'E2E idea to promote'); await ideaToIssue(idea.id); await sleep(500); const after = [...document.querySelectorAll('#board .card-title')].map(n => n.innerText); const moved = await invoke('board_set_status', {id: made.issue.id, status: 'blocked', note: 'waiting for a decision'}); document.getElementById('overlay').hidden = true; document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Escape'})); await sleep(300); const closed = document.getElementById('board').hidden; await clean(); return JSON.stringify({assignedTo: made.issue.assignee, track: made.issue.track, childId: child.issue.id.startsWith(made.issue.id + '.'), popup, hasCard: cards.includes('E2E: speed up the rust parser'), promoted: after.includes('E2E idea to promote'), ideasLeft: ideas.list.length, blockedOk: moved.ok && moved.issue.hold === 'waiting for a decision', closed, errors: window.__bridleErrors}); })()
